verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own materials say every task gets an isolated full-stack sandbox with a branched database when needed (docs-14). Live previews of in-progress tasks open without affecting production (docs-7, docs-5), and network access from these isolated sandboxes can be controlled (docs-28). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth docs on how the branched database is created and isolated from production data (only marketing-level claims).
